items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Buddy Rich had had one, he and I. Either the snare drum or that flat – I don’t know if it’s the flat ride, but I don’t – he may even have had one of those

ctx.x: So was that the first time that you recorded that flat ride? How did that come about, getting that flat ride on Now He Sings, Now He Sobs?

I think in Europe that company had – I had one of the first ones. Definitely the first one. I think Buddy Rich had had one, he and I. Either the snare drum or that flat – I don’t know if it’s the flat ride, but I don’t – he may even have had one of those, but I think that was the first one recorded anyhow, because that was – 602s, was that?
